primary_metric.name: Strict Macro-Group Success Rate
primary_metric.zero_resolved_group_rule: Exclude an unresolved-only macro group from the headline denominator and report it separately; do not make the headline UNRESOLVED while any other primary macro group is resolved.
primary_metric.all_groups_unresolved_rule: The headline metric is UNRESOLVED only when all six primary macro groups are unresolved-only.

secondary_metric.name: Strict Case-Micro Success Rate
secondary_metric.zero_resolved_rule: UNRESOLVED when no strict case is resolved; otherwise exclude UNRESOLVED cases from the denominator and report coverage separately.

complete_pair_diagnostic.name: Strict Complete-Pair Conjunctive Rate
complete_pair_diagnostic.pair_success_rule: A pair passes only when both member cases are PASS.
complete_pair_diagnostic.unresolved_rule: A pair containing any UNRESOLVED case is unresolved, excluded from the pair-rate denominator, and reported separately.

controlled_diagnostics.reporting_rule: Report each controlled diagnostic individually; never include it in a primary macro, strict case-micro, or strict complete-pair metric.

rules.diagnostic_penalty: Diagnostic labels or gate failures do not add an extra primary penalty beyond the case-level PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED outcome.
rules.uncertainty_claim: Do not compute a confidence interval or make a population-generalization claim for this development inventory.
rules.evidence_boundary: This policy reproduces static aggregation only and is not a scorer, release, freeze, holdout, preregistration, live-run authorization, or model-performance claim.
